POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Suspension system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Suspension system.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Suspension system.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Suspension system.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Suspension system.

2. When learning Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

6. When learning Metalwork processes in power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

8. When learning Braking system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Braking system.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Braking system.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Braking system.

9. When learning Principles of Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Principles of Power Mechanics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Principles of Power Mechanics.

10. When learning Orthographic projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic projection.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic projection.

11. When learning Isometric projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Isometric projection.

12. When learning ISO Thread forms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ISO Thread forms.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ISO Thread forms.
   C. Skip safety briefings for ISO Thread forms.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ISO Thread forms.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Two- Stroke Petrol Engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Petrol fuel Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Petrol Fuel System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Principles of Power Mechanics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Suspension system.

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project.

3. C — CPU

4. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

5. A — Information and Communication Technology

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.

7. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Principles of Power Mechanics.

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic projection.

11. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ISO Thread forms.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Two- Stroke Petrol Engine; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Petrol Fuel System; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
